contrast_inventory.verdict: No same black-text-on-dark failure reproduced. Native glass is heterogeneous; uniform-ring contract not qualified. No color change or blanket contrast PASS. Off ROI is source-padding-derived control interior, not a reported text frame.

limits: Default and largest Accessibility category only, two simulators, Modular inventory only.
Native picker title/Off are positive font-growth controls, not color contrast controls. Nonuniform glass contrast remains unqualified.
XXXL matrix cancels without choosing an option; actual style/inline selection is normal-size regression evidence, not large-text selection or real assistive certification.
Other FaceEditor option fonts and rendered clock/art fonts are outside this five-role package.
No real Home, accounts, recording, audio, calls/messages, native alarms or new Live Activities; physical/signing hold unchanged.
